## 📡 Signal Search · Beta 2

Two Xray nodes and two sing-box nodes checked in for this Signal Search field test. All four moved traffic at the same time, each on its own mixed port. If your second sing-box node used to sit out the mission with a database-lock error, this one's for you.

**[Download for Windows x64](https://github.com/touka2014/NewEriduProxy/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.2/NewEriduProxy-windows-x64.zip)** · [SHA-256 checksum](https://github.com/touka2014/NewEriduProxy/releases/download/v0.1.0-beta.2/NewEriduProxy-windows-x64.zip.sha256)

### 🎛️ What's new since beta 1

- **Parallel routes.** Each sing-box node opens its own cache database. A parallel node also keeps its assigned mixed port when an older global LAN setting calls for an extra listener. LAN access is still opt-in per node, and the main local listener on port `20808` starts disabled on a fresh install.
- **Subscription refreshes.** A failed import keeps the profiles you already have. Repeated latency tests now save their latest results reliably.
- **Updates and filters.** The updater rejects ZIP entries that point outside the application directory. Subscription, policy-group, and log filters now put a time limit on regex matches.
- **Upstream networking.** This build integrates v2rayN 7.25.6 and mainline fixes through `f07e3dc`, including MASQUE and MASQUE Warp support, Xray TUN improvements, and fixes for DNS and UDP testing. The Windows package includes Xray `26.11.9` and sing-box `1.14.3`.

### 📦 Upgrading from beta 1

1. Close New Eridu Proxy and back up your portable installation's `guiConfigs` folder.
2. Download the ZIP and its checksum into the same folder. Run the following in PowerShell from that folder. A match prints `True`.

   ```powershell
   $zip = 'NewEriduProxy-windows-x64.zip'
   $expected = ((Get-Content -Raw "$zip.sha256") -split '\s+')[0]
   (Get-FileHash $zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -eq $expected
   ```

3. Extract the complete ZIP into a fresh folder. To carry over your profiles and settings, copy the backed-up `guiConfigs` beside the new `NewEriduProxy.exe` before launching it.

### 🧪 Field report

All **676 automated tests** passed during upgrade validation (271 ServiceLib and 405 Web API). The four-core test checked local transfers, per-node LAN binding, live upload and download, saved traffic totals, and selective shutdown. The Windows x64 build also passed local hands-on testing.

Thanks to the v2rayN, Xray, sing-box, and v2fly contributors who made this dispatch possible. [Full changelog since beta 1](https://github.com/touka2014/NewEriduProxy/compare/v0.1.0-beta.1...v0.1.0-beta.2)
